slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Theorem: if two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, then corresponding angles are equal, alternate interior angles are equal, and same-side interior angles are supplementary.

Proof: through the crossing point on one line, construct the line that makes alternate interior angles equal. By 5.6 it is parallel to the other line. By the Parallel Postulate there is only one such parallel, so it is the given line. All eight angles are then one of two measures, x and 180 − x.
